item.title: 🇷🇺 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting with President of Turkiye Recep Tayyip Erdogan
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇹🇷 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting with President of Turkiye Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Bishkek, September 1, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin: I am very glad to meet with you again. It has indeed been quite some time since we last met in person , although we continue to keep our bilateral relations under close review . Turkiye is one of our privileged partners both in foreign policy and in the economic sphere . The Intergovernmental Commission is working actively. Thanks to your personal attention to the development of our ties, economic cooperation remains at a high level. Major joint projects are continuing . One of the best known is the Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant . It is being built in Turkiye, and you tasked our company Rosatom with launching the first unit this year – and that is exactly what will happen. The company is on schedule . There is also considerable potential for expanding cooperation in the cultural and humanitarian sphere . The number of Russian tourists visiting Turkiye continues to grow. In 2025, the figure reached nearly 7 million people . 🤝 Today we have an opportunity to discuss these and all other issues of mutual interest. #RussiaTurkiye

Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
I am very pleased
to see you again
, this time here at the SCO Summit in Kyrgyzstan. As you know, we use
every opportunity
to meet, talk and hold consultations.
Friendly Russia-Iran relations continue to develop steadily across all areas,
in keeping with the letter and spirit of
the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
.
☝️
As I have said on many occasions, Russia stands in solidarity with the people of Iran
. We admire your courage and resilience in defending your national interests. Please convey my greetings and sincere words of support to Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic
Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei.
We welcomed the conclusion in June of this year of the Iran-US ceasefire memorandum
, but unfortunately
the ceasefire proved unstable and overly fragile
.
During this difficult period, we have been trying to provide you with the assistance you need. We have discussed this with you, and
we are supplying the necessary goods
.
Despite the military and political situation,
we have maintained last year’s momentum in trade, economic ties and cooperation
. This is due first and foremost to the effective work of the intergovernmental commission, which meets regularly and held another session quite recently.
The free trade agreement between the EAEU and Iran
is also, in my view,
an important factor.
Considerable attention is also being paid to expanding humanitarian cooperation
: more and more Iranian students are choosing to study in Russia, which we are very pleased to see. A large number of future medical professionals are studying in Russia. In the 2025-2026 academic year,
the number of Iranian students in Russia approached 9,000
, including 802 studying at the expense of the Russian federal budget.
🤝
We have many issues to discuss
. I am very pleased to have this opportunity to meet with you and your team today.
#RussiaIran

Following
the meeting
of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation,
the Bishkek Declaration on the 25th Anniversary of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
was signed
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
🤝
We, the Leaders of the Member States of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
(
#SCO
), gathered for a regular meeting of the Council of Heads of State and marking the 25th anniversary of the SCO,
reaffirm our firm commitment
to the goals and principles enshrined in
the SCO Charter
, as well as to further strengthening good-neighbourliness, friendship and effective multifaceted cooperation, and
declare
:
Since its establishment, the Organisation has
successfully passed
through a historic stage of institutional and conceptual development and
established itself as a widely recognised and dynamically developing multilateral association
, the role of which in international and regional affairs continues to grow steadily.
Over the past quarter-century,
a solid legal foundation for the SCO’s activities and effective mechanisms of cooperation
have been established, while strategic directions for its further development have been defined.
The Member States will continue their efforts
to further consolidate the SCO
in implementing the tasks and achieving the goals set out in
the SCO Development Strategy until 2035
.
***
Key provisions
:
✍️
The Member States
•
Reaffirm their unwavering commitment to the universal norms and principles of international law enshrined in
the UN Charter
and stress the need to strengthen the UN’s role as a guarantor of international peace and security, sustainable development, and the establishment of a representative, democratic and just
#MultipolarWorld
. They are making a growing contribution to collective efforts to improve the global system of governance.
•
Advocate ensuring sustainable international peace
and
call for joint efforts
to counter traditional and emerging security challenges and threats.
• Expressing concern over growing information security risks,
strongly oppose the militarisation of the information and communications technology (ICT) sphere
and the creation of threats to critical information infrastructure.
•
Reaffirm the need to ensure the safe and responsible use of artificial intelligence technologies
, including the inadmissibility of their use to deliberately cause harm to human life and health, as well as to the national security, territorial integrity and sovereignty of states.
•
Oppose unilateral coercive measures that run counter to
the UN Charter
and other norms of international law
, as well as the rules and principles of
the World Trade Organization
, and which undermine international security interests, including food, energy and humanitarian security, and adversely affect the global economy.
•
Support reform of the international financial architecture
aimed at increasing the representation and strengthening the role of developing countries in the governing bodies of international financial institutions, including
the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
and
the International Monetary Fund
.
• Underscoring the significance of the 200th anniversary of
Leo Tolstoy’s
birth and the 100th anniversary of
Chingiz Aitmatov’s
birth,
support initiatives to hold SCO events in 2028 dedicated to the memory of these outstanding writers
, who made an invaluable contribution to world literature, the advancement of humanistic values and the strengthening of cultural and humanitarian ties between peoples.

irresponsible and groundless speculations

Politico.eu

impeccable track record,

#ElDabaa

— to present their another fake story as yet would-be sensation and make people believe that Cairo has accumulated a plethora of claims regarding Russian contractors who allegedly fail to perform their obligations towards Egypt.

hastily concocted fake story

and

The objective behind this orchestrated informational attack is also clear

'Rosatom'

to
drive a wedge into Moscow’s cooperation with Cairo.
On the very day the fake story was disseminated by
Politico.eu

Egyptian colleagues offered a rebuttal
to denounce the insinuations with the Nuclear Power Plants Authority accusing Politico of spreading

— a
cutting-edge
for the global nuclear energy sector, including in terms of safety. The

has confirmed on numerous occasions —
Russia’s nuclear energy solutions are reliable and effective.
The IAEA has had nothing but praise for Rosatom’s competence and solutions.

#RussiaEgypt
joint atomic project is being built
in full swing

thanks to the coordinated efforts by the Russian and Egyptian specialists
that we have been able to perform the most daunting tasks in terms of engineering, assembly and technology.
Contrary to all the allegations circulating in the Western media mainstream, Russia has been helping its partners and allies reinforce their sovereignty by carrying out

🎙
Statement
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the SCO Plus meeting
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
SCO Plus meetings
have become a good tradition
. In my view, this once again confirms that the international community’s interest in our organisation’s multifaceted activities continues to grow.
Russia is open to honest, mutually beneficial cooperation
based on equality and mutual benefit, while respecting each other’s interests and values, cultures and traditions.
I consider the theme proposed by the Kyrgyz Chairmanship for today’s meeting highly relevant:
“The UN as a Key Element of a Just World Order: The Contribution of SCO Plus Countries to Building a Multipolar World”
.
☝️
There is no doubt that the UN plays, and must continue to play, a central role in world affairs
.
Let me recall that last year
the UN marked its anniversary
: eight decades ago,
our countries and peoples
,
having defeated Nazism and militarism in World War II
– and today, September 1, marks
the day in 1939 when that terrible war began
–
were able to unite, find a balance of interests and agree on the fundamental rules of interstate relations
.
These principles were enshrined in
the UN Charter
in their entirety and interconnectedness
. Since then, the UN has served as a unique platform for dialogue, diplomacy and cooperation.
***
🇺🇳
The UN’s potential remains far from fully realised
.
It is important to make efforts
to improve its effectiveness
,
broaden representation in its bodies
, including the Security Council, by giving a greater role to countries of the Global South and East, and
generally adapt the organisation to changing realities and the fundamental shifts
taking place in global politics and the economy.
We are witnessing the emergence of a new, genuinely just
#MultipolarWorld
. This process is
objective
and, frankly, as everyone already understands,
irreversible
. Many states seek to determine their own destiny, firmly defend their legitimate interests and actively participate in international affairs.
Against this backdrop, the UN’s unifying and constructive role is very much in demand
. The world organisation must undoubtedly retain its function as the principal mechanism for reconciling interests. That is precisely what it was created to be from the outset – a mechanism for reconciling interests.
The UN cannot be an organisation that advances the interests of one country or a group of countries
.I repeat: the UN must remain the primary mechanism for balancing interests, not least because no comparable mechanism exists anywhere else in the world.
❗️
The UN Charter
must continue to serve as a key source of international law
.
At the same time, alongside the UN, the architecture of a
#MultipolarWorld
naturally incorporates
new multilateral regional structures
that have emerged and gained strength in Asia, Africa and Latin America. Our
Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
is an example.

🎙
Statement
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
Over the past quarter century,
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
(
#SCO
) has come a truly long way.
Let me recall that it was established in 2001 at the initiative of six states –
Russia, China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan
and
Uzbekistan
– and has since grown stronger and expanded, becoming one of the independent and influential centers of the emerging
#MultupolarWorld
.
Today, the SCO is effectively
the largest regional association
not only on our common Eurasian continent, but in the world as a whole. Its member states are home to
almost half of the world’s population
and account for
more than one-third of global GDP
.
The members of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
actively interact in politics, the economy and the humanitarian sphere
. This cooperation helps ensure the steady and sustainable development of each of our states and contributes to an atmosphere of peace and stability, trust and cooperation across our common Eurasian continent.
✍️
I am convinced that
the substantial package of decisions
prepared for approval by the Leaders
following today’s meeting will give new impetus to our partnership
within the SCO.
***
Among the practical priorities facing the SCO, I would particularly highlight
the further strengthening of commercial ties between member states
. This brings clear benefits to all of us and genuinely contributes to steady socioeconomic growth and improved living standards.
📈
Mutual trade and investment continue to grow year after year
. For example, Russia’s trade with SCO countries
exceeded $400 billion
in 2025, while our states are increasingly using national currencies in mutual settlements. In Russia’s transactions with SCO members, their share now
exceeds 98%
.
The SCO Business Council
and
Interbank Consortium
make
a major contribution to implementing joint, mutually beneficial economic projects
. In the future,
the Development Bank
now being established within our Organisation could also join this work. In my view, it should be
as independent as possible
from the financial systems of states that use economic instruments as weapons to gain unilateral advantages in international affairs.
I believe it is in our common interest to continue pursuing
a coordinated and balanced energy policy
, as provided for in
the SCO Energy Cooperation Strategy through 2030
.
☝️
We are pleased with the highly dynamic and substantive nature of cultural and humanitarian cooperation within the SCO
. Ties between our countries are expanding in education, healthcare, environmental protection, science and youth exchanges.
The SCO University
, which brings together
more than 100 universities
from our countries, is operating successfully.
Women’s forums
are also held under the Organisation’s auspices, focusing on strengthening the role of women in public, political, business and social life.
Yesterday, we attended
the opening of the World Nomad Games
now underway in Kyrgyzstan, with representatives from many SCO countries taking part, including Russia.
Our country is ready to host the next Games in Kazan
in 2028
. We will be pleased to welcome teams from interested states.
In keeping with tradition,
we also look forward to welcoming cultural and artistic figures from SCO countries
to
the International United Cultures Forum
, which will be held in St Petersburg in late September.
🤝
I am convinced that
our joint work in Bishkek will help advance multifaceted cooperation within the SCO
in the interests of strengthening security, peaceful development and prosperity throughout Eurasia.
In this regard, dear friends, I would like to recall that today, September 1, marks
the beginning of World War II
.
We must do everything possible to prevent the provocation of armed conflicts from becoming part of international practice
. I am convinced that our work is helping move us in that direction.
